title: Dr. Bluhm's Delight (Gaye Fifer variation)
author: Rick Mohr
problems: Row 2 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 9 "form a right diagonal ocean wave & balance - larks by left hands and neighbors by right hands" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the right diagonal.
Row 11 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
Row 11 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 7 "form an ocean wave & balance - robins by left hands and neighbors by right hands" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.
Row 1 "slide left along set (slightly)" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 (couple 1) must stand on a side line.
Row 3 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 4 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 5 "star left - hands across - 2 places, larks drop out" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
